phases.objective: Run every frontend generator and OpenAPI contract independently, publish a run-bound no-log summary, and enforce the combined decision only after every outcome is captured.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Each generator, parity, route, auth-sync, and deterministic-output contract has an independently attributable outcome in a run-bound secret-free Artifact before the workflow passes or fails.
steps: Generate the source-pinned frontend dispatch plan from the canonical default-branch baseline.
Run the workflow baseline, operation generator, surface dispatch, auth parity, route coverage, and OpenAPI auth synchronization contracts independently.
Check committed deterministic generated output independently.
Build one bounded summary containing only check IDs, outcomes, exact candidate SHA, and safety declarations.
Upload the summary with a run-bound Artifact name.
Fail once at the final decision step when any captured outcome is not successful.
assertions: The original Verify generator contract marker remains present for baseline semantics.
No individual contract short-circuits collection of later outcomes.
The summary declares consult_job_logs=false, repository_mutation=false, and secrets_included=false.
Generator implementations and committed generated outputs are unchanged by this governance repair.
No runtime, provider, credential, migration, deployment, main, or Production authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Publish the structured frontend generator decision into the shared trusted PR evidence comment.
Retain individual outcomes across runner cancellation and generated-refresh synchronization races.
This repository CI governance repair performs no live canary.
This change grants no deployment or Production authority.
